name: io.github.tonyyang0504/kakao-mcp
description: KakaoTalk (messaging): me, send. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KAKAO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: REST API key of the Kakao app ([App] > [Platform Key] > [REST API key]), sent as client_id to POST https://kauth.kakao.com/oauth/token (https://developers.kakao.com/docs/en/kakaologin/rest-api).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KAKAO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of the REST API key; 'Required when the setting is [ON]' (enabled by default for new keys).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KAKAO_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from Kakao Login (authorization code flow) of the SENDING user, with consent to the talk_message scope and friends-list access (friends scope); valid about 60 days (refresh_token_expires_in 5184000). Kakao returns a renewed refresh_token when less than a month is left: the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/kakao.json (mode 0600).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KAKAO_LINK_URL
environmentVariables.description: Web URL opened when the message is tapped (text template link.web_url / mobile_web_url, 'O' required); its domain must be registered as a Web domain under Product Link on the app management page (https://developers.kakao.com/docs/en/message-template/default).
